name: grafana-react-sdk-poc-root
description: Disposable private research workspace for the Grafana native-rendering POC.

scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @grafana-react-sdk/poc-host typecheck && yarn workspace @grafana-react-sdk/poc-compat typecheck && yarn workspace @grafana-react-sdk/poc-grafana-bridge typecheck
scripts.inspect:bundle: yarn build:poc && node --eval 'const fs = require("node:fs"); const path = require("node:path"); const banned = /public\/app\/app(?:\.ts)?|GrafanaApp\.init/; const hits = []; const walk = (dir) => { for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) { const file = path.join(dir, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(file); else if (/\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/.test(entry.name) && banned.test(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"))) hits.push(file); } }; for (const root of ["apps", "packages"]) walk(root); if (hits.length) { console.error(`Forbidden Grafana application-shell import found:\n${hits.join("\n")}`); process.exit(1); } console.log("No forbidden Grafana application-shell imports found.");'
